description: Read the project's apps, allowed calls, limits, state, idle flags and anomaly-guard settings. Use it to select an app id. Use gate_manage_app_key to rotate its key or revoke a retired app.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...
